author: TreeGuy1991
body: Hi guysCan you become a meber of staff if u have been kicked/tempbaned?Im asking this because maybe in the future if im applying for staff I want to know if this will affect me.
body_tagged: Hi guysCan you become a meber of staff if u have been kicked/tempbaned?Im asking this because maybe in the future if im applying for staff I want to know if this will affect me.
title: Staff Question

replies.author: vladthegreat100
replies.body: Yes you are able, and no it does not affect you during the process of applying (unless you do it often, or during the applying process), I got denied for 1 kick during that xD

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Yes of course! Normally it doesn't matter how much infractions you have. But it would help you if you don't get many infractions in short time, like 10 infractions in one week or so. Oh and don't get infractions while you applied as mod.

Major infractions are bans/tempbans.

replies.body: Bans, Long Temp-Bans, stuff like that. However, a few minor infractions shouldn't effect you. I mean, I have a few infractions from before I was staff, and I got accepted, so there's still a chance. Just make sure you fill out a good application! ^-^

replies.body: "Major infractions" are things like permanent bans, bans for having too many infractions and generally any bans for hacking or other serious things.

replies.author: vladthegreat100
replies.body:
Correcting everybody here who is saying bans/tempbans are major, its just tempbans, especially multiple tempbans, but bans only affect you when you have had more then one, for example being banned for hacking, if you get unbanned (since its a perma ban) you would probably want to wait 2-3 months without any big infractions, since when you are unbanned you become pardoned which means that the specific infraction will be treated as it never happend
(from what I remember and how it is on MCSG xD)
